questions.question: What is the minimum requirement for developing an oscillator

answers.d: Tank circuit and feed back network

explanations.a: A tank circuit alone cannot maintain oscillation.
explanations.b: Amplifier is necessary but not sufficient alone.
explanations.c: Needs a feedback network to sustain oscillations.
explanations.d: Correct—oscillator requires both a tank circuit and a feedback network.

questions.question: What is the importance of feedback network

answers.b: To provide input to the amplifier

explanations.a: Correct—feedback sustains oscillation in the tank circuit.
explanations.b: Partially true but not the primary function.
explanations.c: Gain comes from the amplifier, not the feedback alone.
explanations.d: Damping is related but not the core reason for feedback.
